meta.name: Power Rangers R.P.M.
meta.description: The computer virus Venjix wants to attack and destroy Corinth, the only city on Earth to survive its massacre. With the help of advanced biotechnology, RPM Power Rangers must save humanity and defeat Venjix.

videos.name: The Road to Corinth
videos.overview: The Venjix computer network is laying ruin to the entire planet, and the human race has retreated into the environmentally shielded city of Corinth.
videos.description: The Venjix computer network is laying ruin to the entire planet, and the human race has retreated into the environmentally shielded city of Corinth.

videos.name: Fade to Black
videos.overview: As Venjix grows stronger, it becomes clear that the Rangers need more than three operators to defend the city.
videos.description: As Venjix grows stronger, it becomes clear that the Rangers need more than three operators to defend the city.

videos.name: Rain
videos.overview: Dillon goes through a series of tests to see if he even is Ranger material, but the real test comes when he is faced with the choice of seeking out his past or helping the Rangers as promised.
videos.description: Dillon goes through a series of tests to see if he even is Ranger material, but the real test comes when he is faced with the choice of seeking out his past or helping the Rangers as promised.

videos.name: Go for the Green
videos.overview: When Ziggy is charged with finding the new Green Ranger, he finds the perfect candidate in Tenaya 7, until he realizes she's a machine working for Venjix!
videos.description: When Ziggy is charged with finding the new Green Ranger, he finds the perfect candidate in Tenaya 7, until he realizes she's a machine working for Venjix!

videos.name: Handshake
videos.overview: When Dillon struggles to activate the invincibility mode of his suit, he challenges Dr. K to come out from behind their protective screen.
videos.description: When Dillon struggles to activate the invincibility mode of his suit, he challenges Dr. K to come out from behind their protective screen.

videos.name: Ranger Green
videos.overview: Ziggy's recruitment as Ranger Green is put into question when parts of his shady past are revealed. Should the Rangers work with someone who is hated by all seven of Corinth's cartels?
videos.description: Ziggy's recruitment as Ranger Green is put into question when parts of his shady past are revealed. Should the Rangers work with someone who is hated by all seven of Corinth's cartels?

videos.name: Ranger Red
videos.overview: Scott is flooded with memories of his brother when he returns to Marcus' crash site in order to retrieve an over thruster core the Rangers need for the new Megazord configuration.
videos.description: Scott is flooded with memories of his brother when he returns to Marcus' crash site in order to retrieve an over thruster core the Rangers need for the new Megazord configuration.

videos.name: Ranger Yellow (1)
videos.overview: Mr. and Mrs. Landsdown suddenly reappear in Summer's life, intent on making their daughter live up to her promise to marry into a wealthy family.
videos.description: Mr. and Mrs. Landsdown suddenly reappear in Summer's life, intent on making their daughter live up to her promise to marry into a wealthy family.

videos.name: Ranger Yellow (2)
videos.overview: Diamonds and pretty dresses are no longer important to Summer, who finds her true meaning in what she does with the Rangers.
videos.description: Diamonds and pretty dresses are no longer important to Summer, who finds her true meaning in what she does with the Rangers.

videos.name: Ranger Blue
videos.overview: All his life, all Flynn ever wanted to do was to help people, but his heroics as the Blue Ranger are cut short when there is a malfunction in his suit.
videos.description: All his life, all Flynn ever wanted to do was to help people, but his heroics as the Blue Ranger are cut short when there is a malfunction in his suit.

videos.name: Doctor K
videos.overview: While attempting to overcome a power problem with the Rangers' new Zord configuration, Doctor K is haunted by a terrible mistake.
videos.description: While attempting to overcome a power problem with the Rangers' new Zord configuration, Doctor K is haunted by a terrible mistake.

videos.name: Blitz
videos.overview: When Venjix sends an attack bot from Dillon's past to infiltrate the city, Dillon is torn between destroying the bot, or finally finding the answers to his past.
videos.description: When Venjix sends an attack bot from Dillon's past to infiltrate the city, Dillon is torn between destroying the bot, or finally finding the answers to his past.

videos.name: Brother’s Keeper
videos.overview: As the Venjix Virus comes closer to taking over Dillon entirely, the other Rangers and Dr. K race to find a way to slow the growth rate of the virus.
videos.description: As the Venjix Virus comes closer to taking over Dillon entirely, the other Rangers and Dr. K race to find a way to slow the growth rate of the virus.

videos.name: Embodied
videos.overview: Seeking answers to Dillon's past, the Rangers go outside Corinth to a place Dillon thinks he remembers, unaware that it's a trap set by Venjix himself.

videos.name: In or Out
videos.overview: As the Rangers take a more offensive approach against Venjix, the virus traps the citizens of Corinth inside their own dome and proceeds to suck all the air out of the city.
